d.d: To regurgitate or eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth; puke.
To regurgitate and discharge (something swallowed); to spew.
To eject from any hollow place; to belch forth; to emit.
d.x: She snapped and started vomiting curses at us.

d.d: The regurgitated former contents of a stomach; vomitus.
